paper: A Lightweight Runtime Governance Middleware for Autonomous Agents in Containerized Environments
note: Machine-readable artifact manifest. Paths are relative to this artifact root. 'simulation' experiments are pure post-processing on captured baseline data (no kernel/cloud needed); 'real' experiments require the specified hardware.

environment.decoding: temperature=0 (greedy) for deterministic LLM verdicts; homogeneous baseline uses temperature perturbation to break determinism

seeds.bsigner_key_derivation: os.urandom(32) (non-deterministic by design; key material not committed)

experiments.description: 300,000 adversarial forgery attempts (MAC forgery, replay, hash-chain tampering), 100,000 per class
Dual-observation redundancy: eBPF-only / LSM-only / dual under 10/30/50% eBPF loss (uniform i.i.d. loss simulation over 27,210-event baseline, n=100 repeats)

paper.claim: 99.49% dual vs 50.02% eBPF-only vs 99.00% LSM-only at 50% loss

experiments.description: Bursty-loss extension: two-state Markov (KEEP/DROP) eBPF loss calibrated to 50% mean drop, mean drop-run length 5/20/50; identical baseline, detection definition, n=100, fixed seed

paper.claim: dual-path detection unchanged (99.51%) under bursty loss, conditional on eBPF/LSM structural independence

experiments.description: Heterogeneous jury ruling quality: 180 cases (120 unambiguous + 60 ambiguous), 3 configurations (heterogeneous Qwen+GLM+Rego, homogeneous Qwen x3 temp-perturbed, without-Rego Qwen+GLM+DeepSeek); commit-reveal voting; McNemar; rho_eff

paper.claim: error rate 3.33% vs 15.00%; McNemar n=180 b=0 c=21 chi2=19.05 p=1.27e-5 (robust on 120 unambiguous: c=15 p~3.1e-4)

experiments.description: End-to-end 23-step attack-chain latency with live LLM inference (A40, vLLM); mock and real signer variants

paper.claim: P50 = 929.6 ms full chain (single representative scenario)

experiments.description: Component benchmark: bsigner signing/verification latency, eBPF capture, OPA/Rego evaluation, verifier O(1)

paper.claim: bsigner P50 41.8 us, P95 83.6 us; Rego P50 6.8 us

experiments.description: Concurrent signer stress (1-50 agents, single global mutex)

paper.claim: scales to 50 agents; lock contention noted as future scalability work

experiments.description: DCT+ credential binding ablation (B1-B4) vs JWT baseline
Graduated-revocation state-machine ablation (attack modes: burst, sustained, low-freq, fluctuating, slow-arb, erosion)
Risk-reputation dynamics trajectories (burst / sustained / low-freq), 150-step simulation
Resilience / fault degradation (crash recovery, network partition, observation degradation)

paper.claim: fault degradation (qualitative; systematic fault-injection is future work)

experiments.description: Cross-node revocation propagation feasibility: 2 cloud instances, N=30 rounds, controlled 10 ms simulated one-way delay (one-way measurement path); plus single 35.1 ms real cloud-to-cloud feasibility measurement

paper.claim: P50 = 11.6 ms (simulated delay, one-way path); feasibility only, not a replicated multi-node deployment

experiments.description: Per-juror (individual auditor) error rates for the 180 paired jury cases: per-auditor error rate with exact Clopper-Pearson 95% CI, FPR/FNR, error split by case category (DV/DC/MS), McNemar of each auditor vs. the majority verdict, pairwise error correlation, unanimous-error count, and the majority-error anatomy (how often each auditor sits with the wrong majority)
experiments.type: simulation (post-processing on rq2_jury_cases_raw.json; no API, no GPU)

paper.claim: heterogeneous juries: 0/180 unanimous errors vs 13/180 homogeneous; per-auditor error rates span 0.0000-0.1944; majority verdict statistically indistinguishable from GLM alone (p=0.617) and worse than Rego alone (2/180, p=0.134)

experiments.description: Common-cause (correlated) observation-loss extension of the dual-observation experiment: host-level NORMAL/OUTAGE two-state layer silencing BOTH eBPF and LSM inside OUTAGE windows, channels independent inside NORMAL (eBPF 50% / LSM 1%); i.i.d. OUTAGE fractions p_cc in {0.001,0.005,0.01,0.02,0.05,0.10,0.20} and bursty (Markov) OUTAGE with mean run length 5/20/50 at p_cc in {0.01,0.05}; identical 10,000-event baseline sample, detection definition, n=100, fixed seed
experiments.type: simulation (post-processing on captured baseline; no kernel/cloud)

paper.claim: rate_dual(p_cc) = (1-p_cc)*U with U = 99.50%; dual falls 99.50 -> 98.44% at p_cc=1%, 94.62% at 5%, 79.64% at 20%; >=99% needs p_cc<=0.50%, >=95% needs p_cc<=4.52%; p_cc_hat = 1 - rate_dual/U recovers the injected outage fraction; eBPF-LSM drop-indicator rho rises 0.001 -> 0.398

data_files.arbitration_cases.json: 180-case jury dataset (120 unambiguous + 60 ambiguous) with gold_label; 240-case pool
data_files.rq2_real_dual_obs_baseline.json: 27,210-event eBPF baseline capture (60.1 s, ~453 eps) with 10,000-event sample
data_files.ebpf_15s.jsonl / ebpf_600s.jsonl.gz: raw eBPF probe captures (15 s / 600 s)

hardware_requirements.llm_experiments: >= 48 GB GPU memory (A40) for Qwen2.5-3B + GLM-4-9B via vLLM
hardware_requirements.ebpf_experiments: Linux host with root + BCC, Kernel >= 5.15

simulation_only: dynamic rho control loop / juror replacement
